title: First Autonomous AI Command-and-Control Malware Uses Multi-Model Voting System

The malware focuses on stealing credentials and cryptocurrency, with decisions logged to Discord via encrypted
takeaways: Four LLMs vote on actions: DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemini
Actions include credential stealing, code injection, persistence
Stolen data encrypted with AES-256-GCM before transmission to Discord
Binary analyzed contained placeholder API keys suggesting malware-as-a-service model
